responsibility: Generates a header fragment that defines the C-SKY target’s SYSROOT_SUFFIX_SPEC from the multilib layout variables supplied by the build machinery. This build-time shell script consumes MULTILIB_OSDIRNAMES, MULTILIB_OPTIONS, and MULTILIB_MATCHES, recursively enumerates option combinations, folds equivalent subtrees, applies multilib alias matching, and emits the driver spec string used by the C-SKY Linux/ELF configuration to map selected -m target options onto the corresponding sysroot subdirectory names.
